1.overview: Paul greets Timothy, recalls his prayers and longing to see him, and affirms the sincere faith Timothy shares with Lois and Eunice. He urges Timothy to rekindle God’s gift and remain unashamed of the gospel amid suffering, then contrasts those who desert him in Asia with Onesiphorus’s support in Rome and Ephesus.

sections.heading: God’s gift and the gospel charge

2.overview: Paul instructs Timothy to pass on sound teaching, endure hardship, and remember Jesus Christ’s resurrection, while affirming that God’s word remains unbound and that faithfulness leads to life with Christ. He warns against quarrels and false teaching by Hymenaeus and Philetus, then describes those fit for service and the Lord’s servant’s patient response to opponents.

sections.heading: Vessels for Service and Gentle Correction

3.overview: Paul describes the moral corruption of the last days and false teachers who oppose the truth, comparing them to Jannes and Jambres and predicting that their folly will become evident. He contrasts them with Timothy’s knowledge of Paul’s teaching and persecutions, then affirms the Scriptures’ role in making the man of God complete and equipped for every good work.

4.overview: Paul charges Timothy to preach and teach patiently amid coming rejection of sound doctrine, and he describes his approaching death and confidence in the Lord’s reward. He requests Timothy’s visit and supplies, reports on his companions, opponents, and defense, and sends final greetings.
